_description: GOLD DRAGON STUDIO — the Stanford dragon as polished gold metal in a dramatic photo studio. Dark glossy floor for a mirror reflection, a graded backdrop, and warm/magenta/teal emissive softbox quads the gold reflects as crisp bright highlights. Strong warm key + cool rim. THE metal hero.

lights._comment: warm key from camera-right, low and forward so it stays out of frame
soft front fill, low and forward (out of frame)

objects._comment: === DARK GLOSSY FLOOR — near-mirror reflection of the gold ===
=== GRADED BACKDROP — large warm-dark MATTE panel behind the dragon (no grain) ===
=== SIDE PANEL left — cool slate MATTE ===
=== WARM KEY SOFTBOX — high camera-right, faces the dragon's front-right scales so they read as bright polished gold. Tucked up at frame edge ===
=== SECOND WARM SOFTBOX — low camera-front, kicks warm gold into the belly/neck ===
=== MAGENTA ACCENT SOFTBOX — left side, faces +x, magenta glints on the left flank ===
=== TEAL ACCENT SOFTBOX — high behind, cool rim glints along the spine ===
=== OVERHEAD WARM SOFTBOX — big panel above, lights the top scales as bright gold ===
=== POLISHED GOLD DRAGON — scale 7, rests on floor (y-half ~2.47) ===
